source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: A person must not knowingly smoke tobacco in a motor vehicle when a child younger than fourteen is a passenger.
corrections.note: Added the knowingly mental state requirement.

corrections.corrected_statement: When approaching a stop sign, you must stop your vehicle at the stop line if one is present and make a complete stop before the vehicle reaches the line.
corrections.note: Added the missing condition that the rule applies when approaching a stop sign.

corrections.corrected_statement: When passing vehicles on multilane roads, the far left lane is intended for passing slower vehicles.
corrections.note: Removed the added prohibition on using the lane as a normal through lane.

corrections.corrected_statement: Sound a sharp blast on your horn when a child or older person is about to walk run or ride into the street or when another car is in danger of hitting you.
corrections.note: Narrowed someone to a child or older person to match the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: A bicyclist who is not on the right side of the lane may be accounting for traffic conditions or preparing to make a left turn.
corrections.note: Changed road conditions to traffic conditions to match the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Bicycle riders are exposed and easily injured in a collision.
corrections.note: Changed seriously injured to easily injured to match the page.

corrections.corrected_statement: Oncoming bicycle traffic is often overlooked.
corrections.note: Removed scanning for larger vehicles reason not stated on the pages.
